eligibility.quote:
I'm having problems with ROS Kinetic + Ubuntu 16.04 + pixel_format=mjpeg. ... When I run the command:

roslaunch usb_cam  usb_cam-test.launch

the following message appears:

swscaler @ 0xc56160] deprecated pixel format used, make sure you did set range correctly

failed_conditions.quote: swscaler @ 0xc56160] deprecated pixel format used, make sure you did set range correctly

loudness.proposed: loud_documented（不变）；detection_stage 应为 run 而非 activate

resolution.quote:
This disables the useless warnings, but it took some time to find:

diff --git a/src/usb_cam.cpp ... +  av_log_set_level(AV_LOG_ERROR);

notes: loudness 分级同意（loud_documented：libswscale 自身打印的诊断命名了问题），仅 detection_stage 不同意。核验：0.3.6（0c3c7cb6）源码中 sws_getContext 位于 mjpeg2rgb()（第 441-452 行，紧跟 avcodec_decode_video），且逐帧创建后即 sws_freeContext；init_mjpeg_decoder（约第 380-400 行，avcodec_open2）不创建 sws 上下文。故首条警告出现在第一帧解码时——运行期，而非激活期。issue 评论亦证其为持续现象："the constant stream of USELESS warnings makes the whole purpose of usb_cam/kinetic on the ONLY platform (Ubuntu 16.04) that it will EVER be used on a complete nightmare."（normanhendrich）。其余核验：(1) FFmpeg n2.8.15 三处代码确认：libswscale/utils.c:1148 警告行；libavcodec/mjpegdec.c:545 "s->avctx->pix_fmt = s->cs_itu601 ? AV_PIX_FMT_YUV422P : AV_PIX_FMT_YUVJ422P;"；libavutil/pixfmt.h:76 YUVJ422P 弃用注释。representation_convention 分类成立（YUVJ 全量程约定值跨界）。(2) PR #115 "Suppress libav \"deprecated pixel format used\" mjpeg warnings" 合并于 2022-10-25（merge 37451954），twdragon 确认 "closed by merging #115"。(3) 分辨率 recommended 成立：normanhendrich 自行应用同一行并报告警告消失，但未给出其 FFmpeg 修订，两单元未按修订识别。(4) tanshiheng 方案 "does NOT work for me. Node crashes." 系对提议方案的否定，非本组合的额外失败交互，不构成遗漏条件。
